items.title: KeyBank Parent KeyCorp (KEY) Lands Founding Partner Role With Cleveland WNBA Team
items.summary: KeyBank, part of KeyCorp (NYSE:KEY), has been named the first Founding Partner of Cleveland's new WNBA franchise. The multiyear agreement includes major community engagement initiatives and fan-focused events tied to the team. The partnership positions KeyBank closely with a new professional sports organization in its home market.
